Indications:

The salt for nerves and mind. Kalium phosphoricum helps to find a balanced state of mind and stabilizes the nervous system. It is indicated in case of mental, emotional and physical exhaustion and general states of weakness and fatigue. It supports treatment of chronic depression, anxiety, insomnia (sleeplessness), nerve disorders, nervous indigestion, restlessness, irritability, incapability of doing mental work, examination fear and back pain or for any other indication, as recommended by your physician.
 

DOSAGE:

Adults 4 tablets 4 times daily, children 2 tablets 4 times daily.

Dr.Reckeweg's extra soft tablet dissolves instantly in mouth.
